units: Targ. Gen. V, 3; a. v. fr.—Part. חָאִי, חָיֵי.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 21:8">Targ. Y. Num. XXI, 8</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 8:3">Targ. Deut. VIII, 3</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Taanit 25a:19">Taan. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>דחֲיִית … או דחָיֵינָא</he> (v. Ms. M. a. Rashi) is what I have lived more or what I have yet to live? Answ. <he>דחֲיַית</he> what thou hast lived.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 81a:10">Snh. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>מאן דעביד לכולהו הוא דח׳</he> will he only live who practiced all these virtues?; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Chullin 7b:13">Ḥull. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>הא קחזינא דחָיֵי</he> but do’nt we see that they do recover?—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 91a:5">Snh. 91ᵃ</cite> <he>דחָיִין מיתי דמיתי חָיִין</he> if those who live must die, can those who died, live again?; a. fr.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 71:20">Targ. Ps. LXXI, 20</cite> <he>תְּחַיֵּי</he> (some ed. <he>תֶּחִי</he>).
